units.sentence: title: Fulton County commissioners adopt the 2027 budget by their second January meeting
units.evidence_span: The budget shall then be adopted by the board of commissioners by no later than the second regular meeting in January
units.problem: A present-tense headline ("commissioners adopt ... by") reads as a done deal or a certainty. P-005 sets only a deadline ("no later than"), and nothing had been adopted as of Nov 8. It also drops "regular" from "second regular meeting in January".
units.suggested_fix: Fulton County commissioners must adopt the 2027 budget by their second regular January meeting

units.evidence_span: for the purpose of holding budget hearings for Fulton County’s 2027 General Fund Budget

units.sentence: status chip: Budget Commission draft due by Nov 15, 2026
units.evidence_span: by no later than November 15, a proposed budget governing expenditures of all county funds

units.sentence: status chip: Board vote due by its 2nd January meeting, expected Jan 20
units.evidence_span: by no later than the second regular meeting in January of the year to which it applies
units.problem: Minor: drops "regular" (the deadline is the second regular meeting in January); "expected Jan 20" is properly hedged (P-041 is a proposed schedule).
units.suggested_fix: Board vote due by its 2nd regular January meeting, expected Jan 20

units.sentence: option chip A: Draft due Nov 15
option chip B: Board can add or cut money
units.evidence_span: whether greater or less than the sums presented in the proposed budget

units.sentence: option chip C: Set aside (filed) Nov 4
units.evidence_span: b. A substitute motion was made by Vice Chair Abdur-Rahman and seconded by Commissioner Thorne, to file. The motion passed

framing_issues.text: Fulton County commissioners adopt the 2027 budget by their second January meeting
framing_issues.issue: As a present-tense headline, it reads as if the budget has been or certainly will be adopted. P-005 sets a deadline ("no later than"), and nothing had been adopted as of Nov 8. It also drops "regular" from "second regular meeting in January".

framing_issues.text: Board vote due by its 2nd January meeting, expected Jan 20
framing_issues.issue: Drops "regular"; the deadline is the second regular meeting in January (P-005). A special called meeting would not count.
Only Option C's chip is styled "bad". The negative styling can read as a judgment on the option rather than its procedural status. A neutral status style would be more even.
